messages:
ana: Heads up 1 opened a PR to update the Kestrel-12b model card (https://git.redwood/workspace/docs/pull/990). Summary: JS + Python snippets use old SDK shapes, limits table lists 12k tokens but bench run shows stable to ~9.5k, embed sharding guidance missing for long contexts, and the benchmark permalink 404s. Can folks take pieces?
ford: I'll take the JS snippets. Which legacy import is present?
\mana: It currently has `const Redwood = require('redwood-sdk')` and `const client = new Redwood()`  should be `import { Client } from '@redwood/sdk'` + `const client = new Client()`. Please add both sync + async streaming examples and a tiny embed-shard helper.
meera: I'll own Python and the embed-sharding recipe. For embed sharding, we should include: split into <=8k token chunks, compute embeddings per chunk, parallelize requests, and return concatenated vectors with chunk offsets in metadata. Also show recommended shard batch sizes (256-512) to avoid OOMs.
chuck: I'll validate the bench. Path is s3://redwood-bench/kestrel-12b/2027-03/perf.csv. The GPU memory graph shows instability after ~9.5k tokens; upstream model metadata lists 12,288. We need to show both: tested max vs catalog ceiling.
nana: Proposed limits wording: "tested max (tokens): 9,500; catalog ceiling: 12,288 (upstream-provided, not validated by Redwood)" and add a footnote with s3 path for reproducibility.
ford: Pushed JS snippet commit. Streaming example uses for-await-of and a tiny embed-shard example in TS: ```ts
import { Client } from '@redwood/sdk'
const client = new Client()
const stream = await client.text.stream({ model: 'kestrel-12b' })
await stream.send('Summarize: ...')
for await (const chunk of stream) process.stdout.write(chunk.delta)
// embed shard helper (pseudo)
async function embedShards(texts){ /* chunk into <=8k, parallel requests, concat */ }
```
meera: Added Python snippet and embed-shard recipe. Python streaming example (sync-ish): ```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
with client.text.stream(model="kestrel-12b") as s:
    s.append("Summarize:")
    for chunk in s.recv_stream():
        print(chunk.text, end="")
``` Also included note: "For very long contexts consider prefix cache TTL tuning and shard-aware metadata to reassemble embeddings."
chuck: Replaced broken bench link with bench index and s3 path: https://bench.redwood/internal/index and s3://redwood-bench/kestrel-12b/2027-03/. Note in PR that the index is internal-only and we include raw s3 for reproducibility.
nana: Add compatibility bullet: "Quant variants: q4f16 tested on Dedicated/Private; hosted offers q4a for low-latency paths. For q4f16 with long contexts, CPU fallback may occur."
ford: One nit in benchmarks: "latency: 120ms @1k"  that was median per-token latency. I'll update to "median per-token latency (120ms @1k)".
meera: Also adding a tiny snippet showing how to parallelize embedding shard requests in python using asyncio.gather and limiting concurrency with a semaphore.
ci-bot: preview: https://staging.docs.redwood/pr-990 - preview will update on new commits.
nana: Final checklist before requesting review: JS snippets (ford), Python + embed recipe (meera), limits table wording + footnote (nana), bench link updates (chuck), compatibility bullet (chuck), copy edits. If no blockers by EOD I'll request review and merge. Thanks :sparkles:
